policy: verified is reserved for generic model-family mappings whose CATEGORY+TYPE are supported by explicit ACRISS/SIPP fleet mappings and are sufficiently stable for a model-only classifier. Provider/market/trim-specific mappings that materially change CATEGORY or TYPE remain strong.

promoted_to_verified.renault_clio: Economy + 4/5 Door (ED) repeatedly published in rental fleets; Elite variants exist but ED is a defensible generic default.
promoted_to_verified.toyota_yaris: Economy + 4/5 Door (ED) repeatedly published; powertrain may vary and remains handled separately.
promoted_to_verified.dacia_sandero: Economy + 4/5 Door (ED) explicitly published by multiple rental fleets.
promoted_to_verified.volkswagen_golf: Compact + 4/5 Door (CD) is a canonical repeated rental mapping; special/Elite variants do not change the generic default.
promoted_to_verified.seat_leon: Compact + 4/5 Door (CD) repeatedly published for the hatchback family.
promoted_to_verified.kia_ceed: Compact + 4/5 Door (CD) repeatedly published by current rental fleets.
promoted_to_verified.ford_focus: Compact + 4/5 Door (CD) repeatedly published; higher-spec Elite examples exist, but CD is the generic default.
promoted_to_verified.skoda_superb: Standard + 4/5 Door (SD) explicitly published by rental fleets for the non-estate model.

downgraded_to_strong.audi_q2: Conflicting published rental mappings for the same model family: e.g. HFAR (Economy Elite SUV) vs DFMR (Compact Elite SUV). F is stable, category is not.

new_verified_entries.renault_grand_scenic: Explicit rental-fleet mapping observed as IVMR; model-family category/type mapping stable enough for model-only use.
new_verified_entries.opel_crossland: Explicit rental-fleet mapping observed as CGMR; C+G stable enough for model-only use.
new_verified_entries.audi_a1: Explicit rental-fleet mappings observed with H+D across manual/automatic groups; first two letters stable.
new_verified_entries.bmw_2_series_gran_tourer: Explicit rental-fleet mapping observed as IVMR; model-family category/type mapping stable enough for model-only use.

notes: verified applies only to the generic model-family CATEGORY+TYPE mapping under this project policy; it does not mean every trim, market, supplier or powertrain carries one universal official ACRISS code.
Passenger-van models require seats/capacity rules to finalize the first two letters where applicable.

Strong entries retain ambiguity where rental suppliers publish materially different category/type assignments or where body/powertrain variants are not distinguishable from the scraped model name alone.
